description:
Scores up to 200 entities in one round-trip — built for agents
evaluating many supply sources during campaign setup. Per-item parse
failures (e.g. a bad domain) are returned inline, with one exception:
a malformed `app_bundle` id rejects the whole batch with 400.

An optional `weights` object re-weights every entity in the call.

Cost:
- Each entity costs one rate-limit unit (the first is the request itself).
  A batch larger than the remaining budget is refused whole with 429 and
  charges nothing beyond that first unit, so the effective maximum per call
  is min(200, remaining + 1): anonymous 10/min, free 50/day, supporter
  500/day, pro 5,000/day, enterprise unlimited.

weights.description: Optional custom weights: an object of `{ type: { component: weight } }`.

name: sigil_score_batch
